Scholarship overview

This Massey scholarship supports food-related doctoral research in New Zealand. It is designed for graduates who completed Massey's Food Technology honours degree through a Singapore tertiary institution. The annual value combines stipend, tuition and research funds rather than representing cash living support alone.

Research Areas

  • Food technology
  • Food research
  • Nutrition-related research

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryNZD 50,000/year total package: stipend, tuition and research funds
DurationThree years
Payment basisTotal annual package includes tuition and research funds; cash stipend is not separately stated

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityEligible Massey Singapore Food Technology graduates
Academic preparationMassey Food Technology (Hons) degree completed through a Singapore tertiary institution, with admission to food-related doctoral study in New Zealand.
Further conditionsStudy in New Zealand; must hold Massey Food Technology (Hons) from a Singapore tertiary institution.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round1 November 2026
LocationNew Zealand
Details checked9 October 2026

Massey offers doctoral research in science, food technology and other disciplines. Its scholarship portfolio includes alumni awards and subject-specific funding, with eligibility and application dates set out for each award.
